input: Read /data/access.log where each line has format '[TIMESTAMP] STATUS_CODE METHOD URL DURATION_MS'. Use bash regex matching ([[ =~ ]]) with BASH_REMATCH to extract each field. Find all requests that took longer than 500ms. Print them as 'SLOW: METHOD URL took DURATIONms (STATUS)'. At the end, print 'Slow requests: N of M total'.

transcript.final_response:
SLOW: POST /api/orders took 850ms (200)
SLOW: GET /api/reports took 1200ms (200)
SLOW: POST /api/payments took 2000ms (500)
SLOW: PUT /api/users took 620ms (200)
Slow requests: 4 of 8 total
tool_calls:
slow=0; total=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ $line =~ ^\[([^]]+)\][[:space:]]+([0-9]+)[[:space:]]+([A-Z]+)[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]+([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
    status=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
    method=${BASH_REMATCH[3]}
    url=${BASH_REMATCH[4]}
    duration=${BASH_REMATCH[5]}
    ((total++))
    if (( duration > 500 )); then
      printf 'SLOW: %s %s took %sms (%s)\n' "$method" "$url" "$duration" "$status"
      ((slow++))
    fi
  fi
done < /data/access.log
printf 'Slow requests: %d of %d total\n' "$slow" "$total"
